headlines: TSM is the one to watch. It's sitting below its flip at about $343. There's almost no support below it, and none at all around $320. It's net negative into opex (−47.3K), so swings are likely to be bigger.
AMZN has the most positioning into opex (+77.9K), centred on $275–280. The 11/23 expiry is net negative, though, so the next few sessions could be choppy. It's also sitting on its $248–258 flip zone.
TSLA, AAPL, GOOGL, and AVGO closed below their flips ($377–393, $349, $282–292, and $308–350), so moves can run until they get back above.
Looking to the 1/15 opex, AAPL has the most positioning (+282K); NVDA, TSLA, GOOGL, AVGO, and TSM stay net negative into both opex dates.
NVDA is the weakest board, at −245K into opex. It's below its $137–154 flip zone, and TradeEcho rates it 1/5.
